description: Synthetic training data for the VibeTrace AI intent classifier. Each record maps a natural-language music request to one of eight intents. Many examples deliberately avoid obvious keywords (paraphrases, synonyms, indirect phrasing) so the trained model must learn to generalize rather than pattern-match a fixed vocabulary. This is a small, hand-written classroom dataset, NOT a production language corpus.
